senses.gloss:
mn. (-लः-लं)
A sprout, a shoot: see किसल.

mn. (-लः-लं)
A sprout or shoot, the extremity of a branch bearing new leaves.
E.
किं diminutive, सल to go, अच affix; also किशल and किसलय.

mn. (-यः-यं)
A young shoot: see किसलय.

m. (-यः-यं)
A sprout, a young shoot: see the preceding.
E.
as before, affix कयञ्; also किशलय.

m. (-ल्पः)
A bed of young leaves, &c.
E.
किशलय, and तल्प a couch; also किशलयशय्या, किशलयशयनं, &c.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Young, infantine.
m. (-रः)
1 A colt.
2 The sun.
3 Benjamin, (Styrax benzoin.)
4 A youth, a lad, one from his birth to the end of his fifteenth year: a minor in law अजातव्यवहारः becoming, after his fifteenth year, subject to suits at law or जातव्यवहार.
E.
किम् what, used contemptuously, शृ to go, and ओरन् Uṇādi affix; also कन् added किशोरकः

r. 10th cl. (किष्कयते)
To kill, to injure.

m. (-न्धः)
A mountain in the south of India, in Mysore, the residence of the monkey prince BĀLĪ.
f. (-न्धा)
A cave in the mountain; also किष्किन्ध्य.

m. (-न्ध्यः)
The mountain Kiṣkindhya, situated in the peninsula in the northern part of Mysore, near the sources of the Pampā river, the territory of BĀLĪ the monkey, from whom it was conquered by RĀMA, and transferred to SUGRĪVA, another monkey chief.
f. (-न्ध्या)
A cave in the mountain of Kiṣkindhya, the peculiar residence of BĀLĪ; also किष्किन्ध.

m. (-पः)
A name of BĀLĪ, a monkey king slain by RĀMA.
E.
किष्किन्ध्य, and अधिप ruler.

mfn. (-ष्कुः-ष्कुः-ष्कु)
Vile, bad, contemptible.
mf. (-ष्कुः)
1 A cubit.
2 A span.
3 The fore-arm.
E.
कै to sound, डिष्कु aff.

m. (-र्व्वा)
1 Sugar cane.
2 A bamboo.
3 A reed, (Arundo tibialis.)
E.
किष्कु a span or cubit, and पर्व्वन् a joint.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
Naked.
m. (-शः)
1 A monkey, an ape.
2 The sun.
E.
क air, water, &c., ईश who has power over, and क aff.

mf. (-र्णः-र्णी)
A tree, (Achyranthes aspera): see अपामार्गः also कीशपर्णक. m. (कः)
E.
कीश a monkey, पर्ण a leaf.
